prompts.title: Explain this error
prompts.text:
Explain this error in plain words: what it means, the single most likely cause, and the first thing to check. No fix yet, and no rewriting my code until I ask.

{clipboard}

prompts.title: Just the command
prompts.text: Give me only the command to {task}. One line, no explanation, no alternatives. If it needs a flag I might regret, add a one-line warning after it.

prompts.title: What does this actually do
prompts.text:
Walk through what this code does, step by step, in the order it runs. Name the inputs it depends on and the side effects it has. Assume I can read code but have never seen this codebase.

{clipboard}

prompts.title: Ask before you build
prompts.text: Before writing any code for {feature}: list the questions you would need answered, your assumption for each if I said nothing, and what you would build under those assumptions. Stop there and wait for my answers.

prompts.title: Smallest change that works
prompts.text:
Make the smallest change that solves this, in the style of the surrounding code. No refactors, no renames, no new abstractions, no drive-by fixes. If you see something else worth changing, list it at the end instead of doing it.

{clipboard}

prompts.title: Three ways, pick one
prompts.text: Give me three ways to {goal}, one paragraph each, with the main trade-off of every option. Then tell me which one you would pick and why, in two sentences. Do not start on any of them.

prompts.title: Argue against this
prompts.text:
Take the other side. List the strongest reasons this is a bad idea, what would have to be true for it to fail, and what I would regret in six months. No balance, no reassurance: the case against only.

{clipboard}

prompts.title: Bugs only, no style
prompts.text:
Review this diff for correctness bugs only: wrong logic, missed edge cases, races, error paths. No naming, formatting or style comments. For each finding, give the line, what breaks, and a concrete input that triggers it.

{clipboard}

prompts.title: Shorter
prompts.text:
Cut this to half its length without losing a point. Keep my voice and my terms, remove hedging, throat-clearing and repeated ideas. Return only the rewritten text.

{clipboard}

prompts.title: Commit message for this
prompts.text:
Write a commit message for this diff: a subject line under 70 characters in the imperative, a blank line, then a body saying what changed and why, not how. No bullet lists, no emoji.

{clipboard}

prompts.title: Summarize what we decided
prompts.text: Summarize this conversation as: decisions made, open questions, and the next concrete step. Three short sections, bullets, nothing that was not actually agreed. Dated {date}.

prompts.title: TL;DR this
prompts.text:
Give me the TL;DR: three bullets, the one thing that matters most first, and whether anything in it needs an action from me. Nothing else.

{clipboard}
